feedback: Works. Oscillates at around 1 MHz.  The 10k pulldown needs to be cut/removed or it will load the output too much and it won't oscillate.  Frequency is also very dependent on the loading on the ua pin. ( scope probe or finger will change freq by 10% easily )
outputs at 1.1Mhz on my board. Important not to load the analog output or it will stop oscillating (there is no buffer)
